Cc: accounts@zenithlogistics.com
Date: Mon, 13 Dec 2027 16:15:00 -0800
Subject: New supplier onboarding - bank details and forms attached

Hi Mina,

Thanks for the call this morning. Per our conversation I attached our completed supplier onboarding packet. Please find:
- zenith_onboarding_form.pdf (completed)
- zenith_w9.pdf
- zenith_bank_letter.pdf (signed by bank officer)

A few notes: our banking partner prefers ACH (USD) for domestic payouts; wires are available but incur a fee. We also have a KMS-backed key management policy for our account statements — I attached a short screenshot of our KMS certificate for your security team to reference (kms_cert_snapshot.png).

We completed the DocuSign for the master supplier agreement (PowerForm) — link included below in case you need it routed to Finance.

Can you confirm expected micro-deposit timing and the remit string that Redwood prefers for PO-level tagging? Also let us know if you need any additional proof (bank-call confirmation or notarized letter).

Thanks,
Elena Ramos
Head of Finance Operations
Zenith Logistics
Attachments: zenith_onboarding_form.pdf (pdf), zenith_w9.pdf (pdf), zenith_bank_letter.pdf (pdf), kms_cert_snapshot.png (image)

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Ramos <elena@zenithlogistics.com>
Cc: priyom_das@redwoodinference.com, jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 13 Dec 2027 17:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: New supplier onboarding - bank details and forms attached

Hi Elena — thanks, received everything and the forms look complete. Quick confirmations and next steps below.

1) Micro-deposits & ACH test: finance (cc'd) runs micro-deposit/ACH verification. Typical timing: 1-2 business days for micro-deposits to reach vendor account, then vendor confirms amounts. If you prefer we can do a $0/verification token via Plaid-style instant verification but that requires a signed consent form — let us know.

2) Remit/PO tagging: Our preferred remit string is: Redwood PO#{PO_NUMBER} — please have invoices include the PO number in the reference line and use the provided remit instruction when you receive the payout. We will send a sample CSV for invoice-labeling to help avoid manual reconciliation.

3) KMS evidence: thanks for the snapshot — our security team may ask for the certificate chain and the KMS provider name (e.g., AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault, HashiCorp). If you can confirm the provider and attach a brief statement on key rotation policy, that will speed the audit.

4) DocuSign: I see the PowerForm link. Finance prefers the signed MA in DocuSign with the routing completed. If you can provide the signed envelope id I’ll attach it to the vendor record.

Finance next steps (Priyom & Jonas) — can you pick this up and run the ACH micro-deposit test tomorrow? Please confirm when completed and paste the micro-deposit amounts in reply to Elena so she can verify.

Thanks —
Mina
Vendor Manager, Redwood Inference
Mobile: (415) 555-0192
